scope: Original code roles composed using this language glossary. Modern proposals, not historically attested compounds. No related-language fallback or opaque collision suffix.

rationale.장치: Native hardware I/O, memory and boot access; not telephony.
rationale.실행관리: ELF validation and user-program execution management; not a times counter.
rationale.묶기: Packs executable bundles; not a network bind operation.
rationale.파일보존: Persistent file storage; not a generic copyright-preservation action.
rationale.x86: Processor architecture name retained intact; x is not a horizontal-coordinate variable in these roles.
rationale.OpenJDK-소스빌드와-자체커널-이식: OpenJDK is a proper project name. Port here means adapting software to a kernel, not a network socket port.
